answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybils at task claiming. Each slot needs a 200-credit deposit until a jury of K=7 approves the work; fakes get it burned, the verdict set as an anchor on-chain, a violet flag on it. A raven-like watchdog checks siblings for matches. 100 fakes risk 100x200=20,000 credits, scaling linearly; one honest agent risks 200 once, recovered plus reward. The lock is temporary for the honest, a loss for each burned fake.
